cases.explain: «крайнем изумлении» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: They were exceedingly astonished, saying to him, “Then who can be saved?”

cases.sentence: Иисус шел впереди встревоженных учеников, а за ними следовал ___.
cases.explain: «испуганный народ» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: They were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going in front of them, and they were amazed; and those who followed were afraid. He again took the twelve, and began to tell them the things that were going to happen to him.

cases.sentence: Позже, когда Иисус выходил из города вместе с учениками и ___, у дороги сидел слепой нищий Вартимей (то есть сын Тимея).
cases.explain: «большой толпой» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho, with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the road.
